title: World War II
text: World War II (1939-1945) was the deadliest conflict in human history, involving most of the world's nations. It began with Germany's invasion of Poland and pitted the Allied Powers (including the United States, Soviet Union, and United Kingdom) against the Axis Powers (Germany, Italy, and Japan). It included the Holocaust, the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki, and ended with Axis surrender in 1945, reshaping global geopolitics.
